title: The TWO cocycles coincide: the additive tower factor a^{2^k}-b^{2^k}=prod(a^{2^j}+b^{2^j}) IS the Galois norm N(alpha)=prod_omega g(omega) bounding the char-p energy defect
evidence: Exact-integer probes scripts/probes/_407_conn/probe_C069.py and probe_C069_decisive.py over prize-regime proper-subgroup primes/params (n=2^mu, mu=3..6; p=1 mod n, p in [n^4,n^5], e.g. n=16 -> p=65537,65617; n=32 -> p=1048609,1048897). Three findings refute the claimed coincidence of the two products. (1) FACTOR-COUNT MISMATCH: the tower product (a-b)*prod_{j<k}(a^{2^j}+b^{2^j}) has k=mu factors; the Galois norm N(alpha)=Res(Phi_n,g)=prod_{omega prim} g(omega) has phi(n)=n/2 factors. For prize n these differ by a factor n/(2 mu) (n=64: 32 vs 6). Not the same product. (2) THE 'group phi(n) embeddings into mu levels of sizes 2^j' GROUPING IS FALSE FOR THE NORM OBJECT: the norm runs over the phi(n)=n/2 PRIMITIVE n-th roots, and the probe's order-histogram shows ALL of them sit at the SINGLE top tower level j=mu-1 ({mu-1: n/2} for every mu). The 'sizes 1,2,...,2^{mu-1}' grouping is the partition of ALL n-th roots BY ORDER (Phi_{2^{j+1}} has 2^j roots), i.e. the full chain mu_2 subset mu_4 subset ... subset mu_n -- the #400 full-group object the prize regime excludes, not the proper-subgroup norm. (3) DIFFERENT POLYNOMIALS: tower factors a^{2^j}+b^{2^j} are bivariate binomials at varying exponent; norm factors g(omega) are ONE fixed signed-monomial g at varying embedding. For generic 2r-term relations g the integer N(g)=Res(Phi_n,g) is not even a difference of n-th powers (probe values 272, 386, 24964, 20866 -- none equal a^n-b^n for small a,b), so the tower factorization does not apply to the actual defect-threshold quantity at all.
honest_note: There IS a true kernel, but it is the WRONG object and is already classical: the 2-power tower binomials ARE the 2-power cyclotomics, a^{2^j}+1 = Phi_{2^{j+1}}(a) exactly (probe (B/C), verified for mu=3..6), so a^n-1 = (a-1)*prod_{j<k}(a^{2^j}+1) = prod_{d|n} Phi_d(a). This connects the tower to the FULL-GROUP curve collision r(c) with c specialized constant (TwoPowerTowerFactorization.pow_two_pow_sub_eq + GVObjectTowerDecomposition.repCount_le_tower_levels, both axiom-clean), NOT to the per-embedding norm Res(Phi_n,g) of a generic additive-energy relation. The primitive cyclotomic Phi_n=Phi_{2^mu} is ONE single tower level (the last binomial a^{2^{mu-1}}+1, degree phi(n)=n/2), not the whole tower product -- so 'the tower stratifies the norm' is exactly backwards: the norm is a single tower level, and the rest of the tower is the sub-subgroups the prize regime forbids. No closure; this should be logged to DISPROOF_LOG as a refuted 'cocycle coincidence' route that welds to the W-anomaly / full-group (#400) wall. The genuine open core (BGK sqrt-cancellation / Bourgain-Shkredov equidistribution for thin mu_n at (2r)^{phi(n)} >= p) is untouched and not claimed.
wall: W-anomaly (full-group #400 trap): the tower's mu-fold per-order stratification is the chain mu_2 subset ... subset mu_n of the FULL group; the norm's phi(n)-fold product over primitive embeddings is the proper-subgroup defect criterion. The connection conflates these, so it provides no level-by-level handle on the proper-subgroup norm and reduces to the already-known anomaly wall.
